From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap + proposed bake-off plan (ZenWell)

Hi Sara / Mike -

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side. Let me know if I've missed anything.

Key pain points you highlighted:
- High per-query latency for clinical-search workflows (SLO: <150ms p95) that is causing slow EMR lookup and clinician frustration.
- Token-level cost has spiked with the current vendor during peak hours; you need predictable unit economics for a 24/7 service.
- Data residency / auditability for logs and KV cache access is required for upcoming compliance audit.

Goals you shared:
1) A proof-of-concept demonstrating consistent p95 latency <= 150ms for 512-token context on a 4x GPU config.
2) Clear cost-per-100k-token estimate under realistic load (50 concurrent users, bursts to 200).
3) Evidence of audit logs + HSM/KMS options for key management.

Competitive bake-off criteria (proposed):
- Latency (p50/p95) on ZenWell test prompts (we'll supply set)
- Throughput under concurrent sessions and autoscaling behavior
- Token-level unit cost (including infra overhead)
- Output quality on clinical extraction and paraphrase tasks (scored)
- Security/compliance controls (KMS, VPC, audit logs)

Proposed timeline + next steps:
1) You share the two sample prompt sets (search + clinical extraction) - target: Mon 11/30
2) Redwood runs a 48-hour bake-off side-by-side with Vendor X using the attached test plan - target: Wed 12/2 start
3) Deliverables: performance report, cost delta analysis, and sample outputs for quality review - delivered by Fri 12/4

Attachments: zenwell_vendor_eval_template.xlsx (test cases + scoring), redwood-bakeoff-test-plan.pdf (execution steps).

Action items for ZenWell:
- Confirm the two prompt sets and any NDAs for sharing real examples
- Confirm preferred contact for procurement (we saw procurement@zenwell.com)

I'll loop Marissa (SE) on execution and we'll follow up with a kickoff calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0198
